guarantees: One existing canonical decoder/range validator checks every visited node before a point result, successful absence or child callback can escape.
Point lookup carries inherited inclusive-lower/exclusive-upper separator bounds; it does not scan unvisited sibling leaves.
Streaming identity and descendant-permission traversal retain one accounted decoded parent per depth, preserve bounded work and avoid per-entry root rescans.
Malformed visited structure remains corruption; ancestor allocation and retained-memory refusal remain operational failures, release reservations and permit retry.
Meaningful native-file fixtures cover both hash widths, read-only source bytes, early success, missing paths, permission refusal and pin cleanup.
Generic hardening routes every manifest fixture through a production decoder, including APAL/APWM, without changing independent bytes, expected errors, allocation ceilings or per-case watchdogs.
limitations: This is visited-structure validation, not full-tree repair or validation of unvisited branches.
Existing fixed workspace reservations and bounded legacy helpers remain; this does not prove universal allocator or host-OOM recovery.
Permission-sensitive Unix test scratch requires POSIX permissions and uses desktop home/ext4, while build artifacts remain on Data.
Task source capture, durable retention, checkpoint/resume, activation, full U1 and U2–U7 remain outstanding.
No task writer, capability advertisement, default-v4 cutover, production deployment or retained FS-Server1 mutation is enabled.
